# Getting help

Start with the [README](../README.md) for launch commands, controls, and the limits of the simulation. Try `uv run jev-robot-web --offline` to check the local demo before investigating a model API problem.

Use [Discussions](https://github.com/arterialist/jev-robot/discussions) for setup questions and experiment ideas. Include your OS, Python version, launch command, and whether the model loops are live or offline. Describe the selected motor mode and active self-thought when asking about robot behavior.

Use a [bug report](https://github.com/arterialist/jev-robot/issues/new/choose) for reproducible defects. Include logs or a recording when they help explain the failure. Remove credentials and private provider responses first.

Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for vulnerabilities and exposed keys.
